purpose: Teach: 淡い/申す/かけがえ/えらく/おぼえ/おろか/無邪気/あきれ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんは淡い色の絵が好きなのよ
lines.en: Sho, I've always loved paintings with soft, gentle colors.
lines.style: Warm, almost dreamy quality. Speaks with the slowness of someone sharing something personal. Soft attack on "Sho." No urgency—she's thinking aloud, inviting him in.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんに「ありがとう」って申す事ができたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I was able to say thank you to Grandpa.
lines.style: Quiet pride in the voice. Not boasting—reporting something he's genuinely proud of. Slight lift at the end, looking for confirmation that it mattered.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんも翔くんは、かけがえのない甥なのよ
lines.en: Sho, you're irreplaceable to me—my precious nephew.
lines.style: Sincere and direct, but never heavy-handed. Warm exhale on his name. The words land gently, like she's trusting him with something true.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お絵描きをえらく頑張ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really worked hard on my drawing.
lines.style: Small, genuine satisfaction in his tone. Not demanding praise—just sharing. Matter-of-fact, the quiet confidence of a child who tried and knows it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんと、おぼえた絵の技を試そうね
lines.en: Sho, let's try out those drawing techniques you've been learning together with me.
lines.style: Encouraging, purposeful. A gentle invitation, not a command. Soft emphasis on "together"—she's including him, not instructing from above.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、おろかな絵を描いちゃったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I ended up drawing something kind of silly.
lines.style: Self-deprecating but not self-conscious. A small laugh underneath, inviting her to share the joke. Dry, matter-of-fact delivery—he's amused by his own imperfection.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんは翔くんの無邪気さが大好きなのよ
lines.en: Sho, I adore your innocence—the way you see the world so openly.
lines.style: Genuine tenderness. Slow, deliberate pacing. Each phrase gets its own small breath. She's looking at him directly, not performing—this is real affection.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お母さんがママのいたずらにあきれてたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Mom was completely exasperated with your pranks.
lines.style: Dry, conspiratorial undertone. A small smile in his voice. He's sharing a small secret with her—he noticed, and he finds it funny too.
